market_demand: 故障確定前または原因未確定の段階で、EPSが観測したpower contextとassist availabilityの関係を知りたい。
runtime_state: Repeated short voltage dip, near-reset context, assist limitation co-occurrence, key-cycle recurrence below permanent under-voltage DTC threshold.
existing_monitor_difference: Value remains only if short dip / near-reset / recurrence context is not fully retained by existing under/over-voltage DTC, reset monitor, or power supply fault.
vehicle_health_contribution: Steering-side power-context observation: EPS observed short supply-voltage instability near assist limitation; not a power root cause decision.
business_output: 製品価値: power contextに対するEPS状態説明。診断価値: reduced assistをEPS内部故障へ短絡しない。品質改善価値: field trend化。顧客技術説明価値: 観測事実と確認順序を説明。
buyer_user: 診断企画, 品質改善, 顧客技術説明, 製品企画
why_supplier_can_play: EPS can define observed supply voltage, reset counter, assist mode, DTC status, key cycle, and recurrence relation.
proceed_condition: Existing monitor does not fully retain soft context, and runtime state explanation can be transferred without root cause claim.
hold_condition: Voltage history is unavailable, event persistence is unavailable, or existing voltage DTC/reset log already explains the state.
stop_kill_boundary: Stop if value requires power root cause, EPS no-fault assertion, replacement timing, safety guarantee, or warranty cost reduction.
what_not_to_claim: Power cause断定, EPS無罪断定, EPS RUL, 交換時期, 故障発生時期, 安全保証, root cause, 保証費削減
next_action: Build one concrete power-monitor case comparing existing monitor retained fields vs missing soft context, then draft minimum vehicle-health payload.

market_demand: 故障確定前または原因未確定の段階で、EPSが観測したdependency signal validityとfallback contextの関係を知りたい。
runtime_state: Intermittent invalid flag, timeout/alive counter increase, fallback entry, steering message co-occurrence below stable hard communication DTC.
existing_monitor_difference: Value remains only if dependency signal validity, timeout trend, fallback state, and steering-side effect are not fully retained by existing timeout/bus-off/invalid-value DTC.
vehicle_health_contribution: Steering-side dependency-context observation: EPS observed unstable dependency signal validity near fallback context; not an external ECU root cause decision.
business_output: 製品価値: by-wire/motion-domainでのcomponent boundary説明。診断価値: dependency contextを読む順番。品質改善価値: service confusion pattern化。顧客技術説明価値: EPS故障/外部ECU原因への短絡回避。
buyer_user: 製品企画, 診断企画, 顧客技術説明, 品質改善
why_supplier_can_play: EPS can define dependency signal validity, timeout/alive counter, fallback state, steering message, related DTC, and steering-side effect when program boundary allows it.
proceed_condition: EPS supplier can define dependency signal, fallback behavior, and steering-side effect; existing DTC does not retain enough context; output is component-side state explanation.
hold_condition: Dependency signal list or fallback state is OEM-owned, existing communication DTC/service manual is sufficient, or work becomes network root cause investigation.
stop_kill_boundary: Stop if EPS supplier cannot define dependency signal/fallback/steering-side effect or value requires external ECU root cause, warranty responsibility, replacement timing, or safety guarantee.
what_not_to_claim: 外部ECU root cause, EPS問題なし断定, EPS RUL, 交換時期, 故障発生時期, 安全保証, 保証責任断定, 保証費削減
next_action: After power-monitor case, test whether dependency signal/fallback fields can be defined without entering OEM network root-cause work.
